image_description: A close-up, slightly angled shot of a vintage-style comic book or pulp magazine cover. The cover features a dark background with cream-colored illustrations of two figures: one appears to be a woman in distress or action pose on the left, and another figure (possibly male) in dynamic motion on the right. The title at the top reads 'MUTLOCH' (or similar gibberish text) in a stylized, distressed font. Below the illustrations is a block of smaller, illegible text resembling credits or taglines. The comic book has a green spine/binding edge visible on the left. The background shows a wooden surface and blurred objects, suggesting a casual indoor setting.

The anatomy of the figure on the right is ambiguous; limbs seem to merge or lack clear joint definition, appearing more like a silhouette than a structured drawing.
